newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt, Saudi to hold joint military exercises.
newsitem.headline: Egypt, Saudi to hold joint military exercises.

text.p: Egypt and Saudi Arabia will hold joint navy and air force training exercises "very soon", the Saudi chief of staff said on Sunday after talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak.
The chief of staff, General Saleh bin Ali al-Muhayya, arrived in Egypt on Saturday for a visit which includes trips to training institutes, army units in the field and arms factories.
"Very soon there will be a joint naval exercise in which the air forces of the two countries will take part," he told reporters. He gave no further details.
The Egyptian and Saudi navies held a joint exercise codenamed Morjan-2 in the Red Sea last August to improve cooperation in planning operations.
